records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao?
records.en: Ao-chan?

records.jp: ……ふう。<CR>ごめん、ちょっと歩き疲れちゃった
records.en_original: ...Phew. Sorry, I'm getting a little tired.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Phew. Sorry, I'm getting a little tired.
records.en: ...Phew.<CR>Sorry, I'm getting a little tired.

records.jp: せっかくだし、ちょっと休んでいく？
records.en_original: Why don't we rest for a bit?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we rest for a bit?
records.en: Why don't we rest for a bit?

records.jp: んー……
records.en_original: Mmmmh...
records.en_auxiliary: Mmmmh...
records.en: Mmmmh...

records.jp: 付き合わせちゃってごめんね
records.en_original: Sorry to make you join me.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to make you join me.
records.en: Sorry to make you join me.

records.jp: ううん。いいの。<CR>わたしもちょっとゆっくりしたいなあ、って思ってたし
records.en_original: No, it's fine. I was just about ready for a break too.
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's fine. I was just about ready for a break too.
records.en: No, it's fine.<CR>I was just about ready for a break too.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんと一緒にこうやってのんびりするの、<CR>結構好き
records.en_original: I like lazing around like this with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I like lazing around like this with you.
records.en: I quite like relaxing like this<CR>together with you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ふふ、そっか。<CR>……私も、結構好き
records.en_original: Hehe, you do? ...I like it too.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you do? ...I like it too.
records.en: Hehe, you do?<CR>...I like it too.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: I'm glad.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad.
records.en: I'm glad.

records.jp: もしかして、こころもちょっと疲れてた？
records.en_original: Were you getting tired too?
records.en_auxiliary: Were you getting tired too?
records.en: Were you getting tired too?

records.jp: ……うん、実は。愛央ちゃんの方から<CR>言い出してくれてちょっとホッとしちゃった
records.en_original: ...Yes, actually. I was kind of relieved that you said it first.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes, actually. I was kind of relieved that you said it first.
records.en: ...Yes, actually. I was a little relieved<CR>when you were the one who suggested it, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 遠慮しないで言ってくれたら良かったのに
records.en_original: You should have said something!
records.en_auxiliary: You should have said something!
records.en: You should have said something!

records.jp: ……いつも、色々動き回って大変だもんね。<CR>もっと甘えたりしてくれても良いんだよ？
records.en_original: It must be tiring for you, always running around. You can rely on me more, you know?
records.en_auxiliary: It must be tiring for you, always running around. You can rely on me more, you know?
records.en: It must be tiring for you, always running around.<CR>You can rely on me more, you know?

records.jp: それは、お互い様
records.en_original: That goes both ways.
records.en_auxiliary: That goes both ways.
records.en: That goes both ways.

records.jp: まあ、そうだけどさ。<CR>こころって、たまに一人で無理しちゃうから
records.en_original: Yeah, I guess so. But you do have a tendency to bite off more than you can chew.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I guess so. But you do have a tendency to bite off more than you can chew.
records.en: That's true, but...<CR>Sometimes you push yourself too hard on your own, Kokoro.

records.jp: うん……心配してくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Yeah... Thanks for looking out for me.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... Thanks for looking out for me.
records.en: Yeah... Thanks for looking out for me.

records.jp: ふー……こうやって木にもたれてると落ち着くね。<CR>やっぱり自然の癒し効果？
records.en_original: Ahh... Lying against this tree is so relaxing. Is this the healing power of nature?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh... Lying against this tree is so relaxing. Is this the healing power of nature?
records.en: Phew... Leaning against a tree like this is relaxing.<CR>Must be the healing power of nature.

records.jp: そうかも。<CR>……昔、こうやって森の中でお昼寝したり、してたな
records.en_original: Must be. I used to take naps in the forest, just like this...
records.en_auxiliary: Must be. I used to take naps in the forest, just like this...
records.en: Maybe.<CR>...Long ago, I used to nap in the woods like this.

records.jp: あ、それイメージぴったりかも。<CR>森ガールっていうの？
records.en_original: That sounds just like you. Like a character out of a fairy tale.
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds just like you. Like a character out of a fairy tale.
records.en: Ah, that image suits you perfectly.<CR>A real forest girl, you know?

records.jp: 本当に昔の話だよ。ちっちゃい頃の
records.en_original: That was a long time ago. I was just a kid.
records.en_auxiliary: That was a long time ago. I was just a kid.
records.en: That was a long time ago. I was just a kid.

records.jp: 木にもたれる姿がなんかさまになってるなー、<CR>と思ったんだよね。動物とか引き寄せちゃう感じ
records.en_original: You do look nice laying on the tree like that. Like you're beckoning animals to gather round.
records.en_auxiliary: You do look nice laying on the tree like that. Like you're beckoning animals to gather round.
records.en: I thought you looked completely at home leaning against the tree.<CR>Like you might draw animals to you.

records.jp: ふふ、何それ。<CR>寄って来るのなんて虫くらいだよ？
records.en_original: Hehe, what are you talking about? Bugs were the only animals I ever saw.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, what are you talking about? Bugs were the only animals I ever saw.
records.en: Hehe, what are you<CR>talking about? Bugs were the only animals I ever saw.

records.jp: 手とか足とか、よく刺されてたなあ……
records.en_original: I always had bites all over my hands and legs.
records.en_auxiliary: I always had bites all over my hands and legs.
records.en: I always had bites all over my hands and legs.

records.jp: 辛い現実だ……
records.en_original: Reality is a cruel mistress...
records.en_auxiliary: Reality is a cruel mistress...
records.en: Reality is a cruel mistress...

records.jp: それ、危なくない？　外で寝ちゃうなんて。<CR>事件に巻き込まれたりとか……
records.en_original: Sleeping outside? That sounds dangerous. Did anything bad ever happen?
records.en_auxiliary: Sleeping outside? That sounds dangerous. Did anything bad ever happen?
records.en: Sleeping outside? That sounds dangerous.<CR>Did anything bad ever happen?

records.jp: あ、それは大丈夫。<CR>外、って言っても家の敷地内だったし……
records.en_original: No, not at all. I may have been outside, but I was still on our property.
records.en_auxiliary: No, not at all. I may have been outside, but I was still on our property.
records.en: No, not at all. I may<CR>have been outside, but I was still on our property.

records.jp: え、何それ。家の中に森があるの？<CR>どんな豪邸？
records.en_original: What, really? You had a forest in your backyard? Did you live in a palace or something?
records.en_auxiliary: What, really? You had a forest in your backyard? Did you live in a palace or something?
records.en: What? You had woods on your property?<CR>What kind of mansion did you live in?

records.jp: 建物は普通だけど……。<CR>家の裏にある森が私有地だったの
records.en_original: No, just a normal house... But my family owned part of the woods behind our house.
records.en_auxiliary: No, just a normal house... But my family owned part of the woods behind our house.
records.en: The building itself was ordinary...<CR>But the woods behind our house were private property.

records.jp: 子どもの頃はそこでよく遊んだり、<CR>お昼寝したりしてたんだ
records.en_original: I would always play there when I was little. And take naps of course!
records.en_auxiliary: I would always play there when I was little. And take naps of course!
records.en: I would always play there when I was little.<CR>And take naps of course!

records.jp: へえー……田舎すごいな
records.en_original: Wow... Growing up in the country sounds awesome.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... Growing up in the country sounds awesome.
records.en: Wow... Growing up in the country sounds awesome.

records.jp: ふわあ……ちょっと眠くなってきちゃった
records.en_original: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy.
records.en_auxiliary: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy.
records.en: *Yawn*... I'm getting sleepy.

records.jp: ふっ
records.en_original: *Fwoooh*
records.en_auxiliary: *Fwoooh*
records.en: *Fwoooh*

records.jp: わひゃっ
records.en_original: Whaaah!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaah!
records.en: Whaaah!

records.jp: あはははは。かわいい反応
records.en_original: Ahahahaha! That was adorable!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahahahaha! That was adorable!
records.en: Ahahahaha! That was adorable!

records.jp: も、もう……！　愛央ちゃんひどい！
records.en_original: Jeez, Ao! You meanie!
records.en_auxiliary: Jeez, Ao! You meanie!
records.en: Jeez, Ao-chan! You meanie!

records.jp: お返しー！
records.en_original: I'm gonna get you back!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna get you back!
records.en: I'm gonna get you back!

records.jp: ふーっ
records.en_original: *Fwooooohh!*
records.en_auxiliary: *Fwooooohh!*
records.en: *Fwooooohh!*

records.jp: ひゃっ、くすぐったっ。<CR>やめっ……！　ごめんって！
records.en_original: Aaaah! That tickles! Stop—I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: Aaaah! That tickles! Stop—I'm sorry, I'm sorry!
records.en: Aaaah! That tickles!<CR>Stop—I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

records.jp: 寝るなら私の膝をお使い
records.en_original: You can use my lap as a pillow if you want.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use my lap as a pillow if you want.
records.en: If you're going to sleep, you can use my lap.

records.jp: じゃあ、お邪魔しちゃおうかな……？
records.en_original: Oh, maybe I will...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, maybe I will...
records.en: Oh, maybe I will...

records.jp: んー……。あー、けっこう寝心地いいかも……
records.en_original: Mm... Ahh, this is pretty comfy...
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... Ahh, this is pretty comfy...
records.en: Mm... Ahh, this is pretty comfy...

records.jp: ゆっくりお休みー
records.en_original: Sweet dreams.
records.en_auxiliary: Sweet dreams.
records.en: Sweet dreams.

records.jp: （……ふふ、かわいいな）
records.en_original: (Hehe. What a cutie.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hehe. What a cutie.)
records.en: (Hehe. What a cutie.)
